defect.reproducer: Launch with subscriber_reliability:=reliable and record:=false. The topic /robot_a/sensor_pose exists, but reliable echo receives no Pose, reports incompatible RELIABILITY and exits with 124.
defect.root_cause: pose_relay offers BEST_EFFORT while the subscriber requests RELIABLE. Topic names and message types match, but reliability policies are incompatible.
defect.proof_after: With subscriber_reliability:=best_effort, live echo receives Pose and exits with 0. The corrected stream was recorded once to MCAP: one topic, 2103 messages. With the live launch stopped, the same bag was replayed using a BEST_EFFORT QoS override. The only publisher was rosbag2_player: reliable echo exited with 124, best_effort echo received Pose and exited with 0.
